name: Non-Linear Gradient Interpolation for Pre-Integrated Volume Rendering
aliases: Pre-Integrated Volume Rendering with Non-Linear Gradient Interpolation
definition: A technique to compute shading in pre-integrated volume rendering by approximating the non-linear path of a normalized gradient vector between front and back sample normals as a quadratic polynomial, avoiding the energy loss and shading errors inherent in linear interpolation (which assumes the normalization term η(t)=1).
summary: Non-linear gradient interpolation improves pre-integrated volume rendering by approximating gradient paths with quadratic polynomials to reduce shading errors inherent in linear methods.
